note: Traverse County park on the east shore of Lake Traverse, off MN-27: an open, lightly treed lawn inside a park road that follows the riprapped shore, with a swimming beach, a small boat harbor and a public landing. Each electric pedestal can take only two campers, and the county shuts the water off in early October. --Claude
summary: County page, rate sheet and park map read: 60 sites (30 electric, 30 without), first come only, vault toilets, well water, RV dump ($5); rates $10/$30 unchanged (sheet undated, slug 2022). Sites 8 -> 60. Lakefront -> lakeview proposed (the sites sit inside the shore road). Phone added, website to the county's current domain; note rewritten.
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront -> lakeview (proposed; default down). On the county map and Esri imagery the park road follows the riprapped Lake Traverse shore the whole way round, and every electric site (24, 25, 27, 29, 30, 32-34 along the north and west road; centre about 45.6672,-96.7838) sits on the inland side of that road, about 30-40 m from the riprap by the map's scale bar, over open lawn with scattered trees; the county's shelter photo shows the lake across that lawn. The campground's own loop road blocks on-water, so these are lakeview. The only sites not behind the road are 35-38 (non-electric, $10, first come) on the lawn round the playground between the boat harbor and the swimming beach (site 36 about 45.6666,-96.7846, roughly 10-20 m from the harbor riprap); no pad or parked rig shows there on imagery, they sit in the beach/harbor day-use area, and nothing says an RV may use them, so they do not carry lakefront.

SITES: the stored count of 8 came from an old note ('8 RV sites with electric'); the county map numbers 60 sites, 30 with electric. Amperage is not posted ('Electrical Pedestals can only handle 2 campers being plugged in. We are not responsible for people overloading the system.'). Pad lengths not posted.

FEES: the county's 'Park Rates' page (URL slug 2022-park-rates, undated, still the current link) gives $10 a day without electric, $30 with, $180 a week with electric, RV dump $5; stored values match, left as stored (rate older than 2024).
SEASON: 'The County Park is Open. Water is planned to be shut off the week of October 5th.' No open/close dates posted; season left unset.
